info.name: PDF Controller API - Document Service
info.description:
Postman collection for the PDFController in the document-service.

The PDFController generates a styled, Cigna-style 'Dental Benefit Summary' PDF for an employee. On input of an employee id it retrieves the Employee, Address and Department data by REUSING the existing EmployeeController (GET /api/employees -> getAllEmployees), which fetches the data from the insurance-claims-system database via a Feign client.

The generated PDF carries the 'cigna' logo on the top-right and the 'cigna2' logo on the top-left, with green section banners and cascading benefit-class tables.

Prerequisites:
  1. eureka-server running (port 8761) - optional but recommended.
  2. insurance-claims-system running on http://localhost:8080 with employee data in its database.
  3. document-service running on http://localhost:8001.

Base path: /api/pdf

item.name: PDF Controller (Dental Benefit Summary)
item.description: Endpoints that generate the Cigna-style Dental Benefit Summary PDF. Base path: /api/pdf

request.description:
Generates the Dental Benefit Summary PDF for the employee whose id equals {{employeeId}} (e.g. id=1).

Flow:
  - PDFController reuses EmployeeController.getAllEmployees() (GET /api/employees) to fetch every employee from the insurance-claims-system database via the Feign client.
  - It filters that list for the requested id.
  - CignaPdfService renders a branded PDF (cigna2 logo top-left, cigna logo top-right, green section banners, cascading benefit tables) containing the Employee, Department and Address details.

Response: 200 OK, Content-Type: application/pdf, Content-Disposition: inline.
In Postman the PDF preview appears in the response body. Use 'Send and Download' to save it.

Errors:
  - 404 Not Found if no employee has the given id (or the insurance-claims-system is unreachable).
  - 500 Internal Server Error if PDF rendering fails.

query.description: When true the response is sent with Content-Disposition: attachment so the browser downloads the file instead of displaying it inline.

request.description: Same as request 1 but sets the optional 'download=true' query parameter. The PDF is returned with Content-Disposition: attachment, prompting the browser to download 'Cigna-Dental-Benefit-Summary-Employee-{id}.pdf'. In Postman use 'Send and Download'.

item.name: 3. List Employees Eligible for a PDF

request.description: Convenience endpoint that returns every employee for which a PDF can be generated (the same data the PDFController reads from EmployeeController.getAllEmployees()). Use it to discover valid employee ids before calling /api/pdf/employee/{id}.

response.name: 200 OK - sample
